title: Double operations that overflow give `±inf`
description: No double operation raises "Overflow": every one whose result is too large for a double gives `inf` or `-inf`, from finite inputs: `1e308 * 10`, `1e308 + 1e308`, `-1e308 - 1e308`, `1e308 / 1e-10`, `power(10, 400)`, `10.0 ** 400`, `exp(1000)` (`exp(709.0)` is finite), `sinh(1000)`, `cosh(1000)`, `gamma(200)`, `lgamma(1e308)`, `degrees(1e308)`, and `power(0, -1)`.
Aggregates too: `sum` and `avg` of `1e308` and `1e308` are `inf`, grouped and over a window; `fsum` of them is NaN; `var_pop` of `1e308` and `-1e308` is `-inf`.
A cast of a double outside `FLOAT`'s range to `FLOAT` raises a conversion error, the one overflow that raises.
reference: An operation on finite doubles whose result is `±inf` raises (`Issue.infinite`, #575): an inferred precondition the written plan checks on the data (`CASE WHEN … THEN error('overflow to infinity')`), as for a `SUM` that leaves 64 bits.

evidence.sql: SELECT 1e308::DOUBLE * 10, 1e308::DOUBLE + 1e308::DOUBLE, 1e308::DOUBLE / 1e-10::DOUBLE, power(10::DOUBLE, 400::DOUBLE), exp(1000::DOUBLE), exp(709.0::DOUBLE), sinh(1000::DOUBLE), gamma(200::DOUBLE), degrees(1e308::DOUBLE), power(0::DOUBLE, -1::DOUBLE)
evidence.observed: inf, inf, inf, inf, inf, 8.218407461554972e+307, inf, inf, inf, inf

evidence.sql: SELECT sum(x), avg(x), fsum(x) FROM (VALUES (1e308::DOUBLE), (1e308::DOUBLE)) t(x)

evidence.observed: Conversion Error: Type DOUBLE with value 1e+308 can't be cast because the value is out of range for the destination type FLOAT

provenance.notes: Run one statement at a time on an in-memory connection with the default settings (`ieee_floating_point_ops` on).
